commercial.q: Can I use generated content commercially?
commercial.a: Yes! Creator and Pro plans include full commercial license. You own the content you create.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept PayPal for now. Stripe support coming soon.

cancel.a: Yes, cancel anytime. Your subscription remains active until the end of the billing period.

switch.a: Yes, upgrade or downgrade anytime. Changes take effect immediately.

free_generations.a: Each time you click Generate and receive output, that counts as one generation. Failed generations do not count.
